title: quenched fresh vietnamese tuna mi quang
description: a paleo-friendly, steam-cooked dish featuring tuna, glassy-jelly texture, and a fresh, adventurous flavor.
instructions: Steam the bok choy for 3 minutes until tender.
Season the tuna steaks with salt and pepper.
In a large pan, mix together coconut milk, fish sauce, lime juice, and palm sugar.
Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat.
Add the steamed bok choy to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the tuna steaks to the pan and cook for 2 minutes per side.
Stir in sesame oil and cook for an additional minute.
Transfer the tuna and sauce to a serving dish.
Garnish with fresh basil and a sprinkle of salt.
Serve immediately with a side of steamed coconut water.
Quench the tuna in the coconut water for 1 minute to achieve the glassy-jelly texture.
